title: Submit a channel draft as one transactional inquiry
requirements: Implement PostgresChannelDraftPort.submit_inquiry for the existing trusted ChannelGateway contract. Accept strict normalized business fields without a public submission token; require an existing non-expired open draft at exactly draft_version and an existing trusted ChannelIdentity. Do not create or merge identities or contact cards.

In one business_write_guard transaction, validate an active catalog option, reuse the identity contact, create NEW Inquiry and InquiryTerms with channel source/snapshots, close and increment the draft, store a CHANNEL_EVENT receipt and channel event, link receipt/audit to the inquiry, and create the existing blocked owner notification job. Commit precedes any success result.

Deduplicate the trusted submit_event_id across every outcome in the same platform/integration namespace. Identical accepted submit replays return the same receipt and inquiry without consulting the now-closed draft; changed fields, changed draft version, or reuse of an event previously accepted for SaveDraft/ResetDraft returns IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH without mutation. A tombstoned result returns RESULT_EXPIRED.

Validate complete nested requester, optional self-reported contact, requested date/time, participant range, experience and comment before mutation. When contact is omitted, derive the current contact kind/value only from the trusted channel platform and external_sender_id; user data cannot override channel_identity_id or source_kind.

Preserve Telegram/VK namespace separation, catalog truth, existing pricing/snapshot semantics and privacy-preserving HMAC markers. Rejected identity, draft/version, input or option cases create no inquiry, receipt, channel event, audit, job or partial draft change.

Add isolated disposable PostgreSQL tests for success, trusted contact reuse, atomic records, stable replay, mismatch including cross-operation event reuse, stale/expired draft, inactive option, strict input, tombstone and Telegram/VK namespace behavior. No SDK, webhook/HTTP route, external call, credential, migration, outbound delivery or bot conversation step table is added.
acceptance: A trusted Telegram or VK adapter can turn exactly one current draft version into one CRM inquiry and safe receipt without a public submission token.
Event, optimistic version and transaction boundaries prevent duplicate or partial inquiries while preserving cross-platform namespaces.
Focused channel gateway tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted transactional bridge from reviewed channel drafts into the existing CRM inquiry and notification persistence model.
